# stagemap

Relation maps for R: things placed by stage (columns) and, where it
helps, by lane (rows), joined by links whose kind means something, such
as built, reviewed, tested by or depends on. The same data answers
questions in code: trace a node, find things with no link, check
coverage, and see the impact of a change. Maps are meant for Shiny apps,
Quarto documents, slides and dashboards, and package websites, and as a
static image for PowerPoint, Word and PDF.

**Status:** early development; `stagemap` is the working name. The
package builds and checks a map object, lays it out and writes it as an
SVG image; the interactive map for Shiny, Quarto and package websites
comes next. It is not on CRAN. Scope and plans:
[`docs/scope.md`](https://github.com/insightsurge/stagemap/blob/main/docs/scope.md).

The coverage badge counts the R code the tests run. The JavaScript
engine that will draw the maps in the browser is tested there and is not
part of that figure.

## Installation

stagemap needs R 4.1.0 or later. Install the development version from
GitHub.

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("insightsurge/stagemap")
```

## Contributing

Open an issue with one of the issue forms before starting work. The
contributing guide is in
[`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`](https://github.com/insightsurge/stagemap/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

# Package index

## Package

- [`stagemap-package`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/stagemap-package.md)
  : stagemap: Relation Maps for 'Shiny' and 'Quarto'

## Build a map

- [`stagemap()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/stagemap.md)
  [`format(`*`<stagemap>`*`)`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/stagemap.md)
  [`print(`*`<stagemap>`*`)`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/stagemap.md)
  : Build a map from nodes and links

## Say what a map means

- [`sm_stages()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_stages.md)
  : Set the order of stages
- [`sm_lanes()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_lanes.md)
  : Set the order of lanes
- [`sm_kinds()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_kinds.md)
  : Set styles for link kinds
- [`sm_kind()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_kind.md)
  : Describe a link kind
- [`sm_groups()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_groups.md)
  : Set group colours and legend labels
- [`sm_status()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_status.md)
  : Set the text of status badges

## Lay out a map

- [`sm_layout()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_layout.md)
  : Set the direction, node order and spacing of a map

## Draw a map

- [`sm_svg()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_svg.md)
  : Write a map as an SVG image

## Ask questions of a map

- [`sm_trace()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_trace.md)
  : Trace links from a node
- [`sm_orphans()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_orphans.md)
  : Find nodes with no links
- [`sm_missing()`](https://insightsurge.github.io/stagemap/reference/sm_missing.md)
  : Find nodes missing a link to a stage
